name: Ruby Receptionists
positioning: A live virtual receptionist and website chat service staffed by people, which uses AI tools to assist its receptionists rather than to replace them.

pricing.model: Monthly plans by receptionist minutes (billed in 60-second increments, rounded up); overage billed at a plan-specific rate. Separate chat plans.
pricing.headline: Receptionist plans: 50 min $250/mo, 100 min $395, 200 min $720, 500 min $1,725.
planNotes: Effective rate on the listed plans runs from about $5.00/min (50 min) to $3.45/min (500 min); these are derived, not published rates.
Chat plans: 10 chats $143, 30 chats $335, 50 chats $520; bundled with a receptionist plan the chat price is 20% lower.
Overage rate is stated as plan-specific but the figure is not published on pages read.
Month to month; money-back refund for first-time users within 21 days or before usage passes 500 receptionist minutes.
Vendor says there are no activation, onboarding or setup fees.
pricing.freeTrial: Money-back refund for first-time users (21 days) rather than a free tier.
whatIsExtra: Minutes over the plan allowance at the plan's overage rate.
Additional fees may apply for transfers to numbers outside North America.

strengths.claim: Live human receptionists, 24/7 including weekends and holidays, which suits callers who prefer a human.
Plans include scheduling, intake, payment collection, outbound call assistance and phone-service hosting at no extra feature cost.
Offers an opt-in HIPAA-compliant receptionist and chat service (vendor statement).
Integrates natively with Clio and Grasshopper, and with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho and others via Zapier.
Uses AI to support receptionists (Call Nav, transcripts, sentiment analysis, robocall filtering) while keeping a human on the call.

limitations.claim: Pricing is by receptionist minute, and the overage rate is plan-specific and not published on the pricing page.
The FAQ says bilingual service and outbound call assists are available Monday to Friday, 5am-6pm Pacific, while the pricing page lists 24/7 bilingual handling as available; confirm with the vendor.

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: opt-in HIPAA-compliant receptionist and chat service (messages delivered via the app/portal rather than email or text). No SOC 2 or GDPR statement found.

telephony.providedNumbers: Ruby assigns a number (area code of choice, toll-free available) that the customer may publish and keep at the end of service; existing numbers can be forwarded and often ported to Ruby.

stepsToLeave: There is no customer-built agent to export: Ruby's receptionists follow call-handling instructions configured for you, which would be recreated in the new platform.
Numbers: the FAQ says the number Ruby assigns can be published and taken with you at the end of service; forwarded numbers simply redirect to the new service.
Messages and transcripts are available in the Ruby App and web portal.
Cancel by phone or email; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current monthly period (immediately in an introductory period).

bestFor: Small businesses that want trained human receptionists answering every call, with AI used behind the scenes.
unknowns: Conflict between the FAQ and pricing page on bilingual and outbound hours.
